steps.repeats: Two dots before a thick double bar line send you back to play the music again, from the start or from the matching repeat sign that faces them. With endings, play the first ending (under the bracket marked 1) the first time; the second time, skip it and play the second ending instead.
steps.odeRepeat: “Ode to Joy” as it’s really built: the same three bars twice, with a different ending each time.
steps.odeRepeatInTime: Now in time: follow the repeat without stopping.
steps.entertainer: “The Entertainer” by Scott Joplin, a ragtime from 1902: the end of its introduction, then its first strain, with a repeat and two endings. Syncopated sixteenths over a steady bass; here the melody is in single notes and the bass on the beats.
steps.entertainerInTime: Now in time, not fast, as Joplin asks.
